description: This file declares structures and functions for managing singly linked lists (`curl_slist`) used in the curl library. It includes function prototypes for duplicating a list and appending data without duplication.

methods.name: Curl_slist_duplicate
methods.description: Duplicates a linked list of `curl_slist` nodes. Returns the first node of the duplicated list or NULL if input is NULL or an error occurs.

methods.name: Curl_slist_append_nodup
methods.description: Appends a string to the list, taking ownership of the string without duplicating it.
